venue: MAGIC MIKE LIVE Theater · SAHARA Las Vegas
address: 2535 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: 100 Level
zones.description: The 100-level sections sit closest around the central performance space. Choose them when being right next to the room energy matters most.

zones.label: Sections 201–202
zones.description: Sections 201–202 are the Sweet Spot / Our Pick: close enough for performer detail while giving the circular staging room to read as a whole.

zones.label: Other 200 Level
zones.description: The rest of the 200 level gives you a strong all-around view of the room from the second ring, with a little more distance than our center picks.

zones.label: 300 Level
zones.description: The 300 level pulls back for a wider look at the choreography and room design while keeping the central stage easy to follow.

zones.label: 400 Level
zones.description: The outer 400-level areas give you the broadest perspective and can be a useful value choice when you want to take in the whole room.
